gloss_text: Someone pressed the bell at the gate. The screen shows a courier with a box. You can open the live feed in the app.
The front door bell rang. The camera caught a visitor on the porch. Open the app to see who came.
Your guest has reached the entrance. Confirm whether to let them in. If you don't respond, the registration will be cancelled automatically.
The courier has been registered at the entrance. Collect the parcel within 30 minutes or it will be returned to the post office.
The entrance sensor triggered and the hallway light turned on by itself. This is a normal log; nothing to do.
Visitor registration at the building entrance is complete. Guest reception is from 14:00 to 16:00. Details are in the management company's app.
Captions are paused. Tap Continue to show captions again.
The Russian speech recognition pack (85 MB) has downloaded and works without the internet.
Live Caption uses your device's language and works without a network connection.
Captions are on. The text of what is playing will appear on screen.
Live Caption will pause automatically at 22:00 tonight to save battery.
Speech detected, transcription started. To stop, turn off captions in Quick Settings.
Important: an urgent update is available! You don't have to install it now; it will download automatically over Wi-Fi.
Storage is running out: 14.2 GB of 15 GB used. Delete unneeded photos and videos to free space.
Battery is below 20%. Turn on battery saver so the device lasts longer.
Overnight backup complete. Photos and settings are safely saved.
Emergency warning: the device is running out of storage. Delete unneeded apps immediately.
One of your favourite apps has new features. You can update it at any time.

Yesterday's café was simply the best! The owner treated us to dessert on the house, everyone was thrilled. Who's going on the bike ride today? The forecast says it will be cloudy after lunch but no rain is promised. If someone brings a camera I'd be grateful, I want to post pictures. And one more thing: transfer your dues by Friday, Lena from the treasury says we're counting everything this time.

Colleagues, the list for Monday's excursion: a water bottle, a raincoat, a handkerchief and a snack. Bus money has already been collected. If anyone can take one more child in their car, please write in this chat by Thursday. I want to plan the seats in the car in advance. Thanks everyone!

I saw some night shots today, the lighting is really great. Does anyone know which lens they were taken with? Mine is a standard one and the frames always come out a bit flat. If anyone is free at the weekend, we could go to the embankment and shoot with a tripod, trying longer exposures. Check the weather forecast and sunset time in advance.

Friends, we're starting to prepare for the summer clean-up in the courtyard. We'll gather next Sunday at 10 am by the entrance; we need rakes, bags and gloves. I'd also like to bake something for tea if anyone has time. If you can't come, just write one word here. Thanks, neighbours!

Forwarding: apparently from tomorrow the main entrance will be closed for repairs, so cars will only be able to enter through the back arch. (Passed on by an acquaintance, not yet checked.) Pass it to people living nearby so they don't make a wasted trip. Someone at the management company supposedly said so; check the notice board for details. No need to panic, we'll sort it out.

Forwarding! Good morning, I hope everything goes well today. As soon as you get this picture, send it to ten people and a present will arrive today! If you don't send it straight away you'll lose out. Please pass it on to everyone. Wishing you health and happiness! I've already sent it to twenty people, but no present yet.

Forwarding: lately strangers have been walking around the entrances and ringing intercoms. Parents and elderly people should not open the door at night without reason. (There are no exact details, do not spread unverified information.) Tell the neighbours; an acquaintance saw two people in black jackets by house 3.

Sharing a health article: supposedly if you drink eight glasses of warm water a day, your blood pressure will drop and insomnia will go away. The headline is loud, but I couldn't find the source, so read it as a rough guide. The club meeting on Saturday goes ahead as usual, in the library on the third floor. If anyone has high blood pressure, ask a doctor first and don't stop your medication on your own.

Dear residents! This Saturday at 9:00 there will be a waste-sorting event in the courtyard. Come with your children, we'll hand out eco bags and prizes on site. Also, from Monday the lift will be switched off for two hours for a technical inspection, so please plan trips in advance. Thanks for understanding! Sign-up closes Friday evening.

Dear parents, on Monday at 15:30 there will be a parents' meeting in the school assembly hall. We'll discuss the revision plan before the tests and the holiday schedule. Please arrive on time, and if you can't come, tell the class teacher in advance. After the meeting we'll explain how to view the diaries electronically.

On Sunday at 8:30 we meet at the park entrance to clean the pond shore. The work takes about two hours. Bring your own gloves and water bottle; we'll hand out bags on site. If you're coming, write Coming in the group so we can count people. After the clean-up there will be a light lunch for all participants.

ATTENTION! Heavy rain may cause flooding on some streets in the district. Do not drive into low-lying areas or cross flooded sections. If you're in danger call 112 and stay on higher ground until rescuers arrive. Keep away from riverbanks and underground car parks, and follow official reports.

URGENT! A gas leak has been found in the third entrance. The gas service has already been called and is on its way. All residents must immediately shut off the gas tap, open windows for ventilation, don't switch on lights or electrical appliances, and don't use fire. Go out to the courtyard and gather by the playground. Please warn elderly neighbours and families with children.

Attention: a fire has broken out in the east block and residents are being evacuated. Blocks one to six, leave now by the stairs to the north square, do not use the lift, and do not go back for belongings. Firefighters are already on site; listen to the staff's instructions there. If anyone is still inside, call 112 right away.

Guest notice: your visitor Andrey Ivanov has reached the entrance and is being registered through the pass system, which will take about three minutes. He is carrying a cardboard box, which the guard has taken. When convenient, confirm in the app whether to let the guest up. If not needed, just decline the registration.

The gate camera noticed a courier waiting to be let in. He says he has groceries. In the app you can watch the live feed and decide whether to let him in. If nothing is done, the notice closes after five minutes, and the parcel will be left in the locker by the entrance.

The visitor log has been updated: two people came into the house this afternoon, a moving company employee and a maintenance technician. Both are registered. You can see the full record on your device; for questions contact the management company. It's a routine notice, nothing needs to be done urgently.
